data.name: 2.5 Day Offshore Island Excursion
data.headline: 2 full dive days for spearos or freedivers
data.description:
Step aboard Escapade for a 2.5-day offshore freediving and spearfishing expedition to San Clemente Island — one of Southern California’s most iconic and consistently productive dive destinations.

This trip delivers two full days of diving and hunting, with overnight offshore time that lets you settle into the rhythm of island life: early drops, long sessions in the water, and evenings anchored off remote coastlines.

With two licensed captains aboard, Escapade can run efficiently and safely offshore, maximizing time on location and allowing the crew to stay flexible as conditions change.

This is an immersive experience — not a rushed day trip — built for divers who want to explore, improve naturally through repetition, and experience what multi-day offshore spearfishing is really like.

Destination: San Clemente Island

San Clemente offers some of the best freediving and spearfishing in Southern California:

Clear water and expansive kelp forests

Reef lines, drop-offs, and offshore structure

Consistent fish life and varied dive profiles

Dive sites are selected based on weather, swell, visibility, and group experience to deliver the best possible sessions each day.

Supported by a professional, well trained, and fun crew

You’ll be backed by a 3-person professional crew, many of whom are experienced freedivers and spearfishing instructors:

2 Captains managing navigation, anchoring, and offshore operations

Deckhand who also serves as an in-water safety diver during dive operations

This level of experience creates smooth logistics, strong safety margins, and efficient dive rotations — allowing divers to relax, focus on their dives, and fully enjoy the experience.

For more seasoned hunters, the crew can target deeper structure and faster-paced drops when conditions allow. For intermediate divers, the trip offers time to explore, build comfort offshore, and dial in technique through multiple days in the water.

Same trip. Same access. The pace adapts to the group.

Who This Trip Is For

Intermediate freedivers ready to step into multi-day offshore diving

Spearfishers looking to experience San Clemente beyond a single day

Divers who value strong crew, thoughtful site selection, and flexibility

Experienced hunters seeking focused time on a premier island

The Platform: Escapade

Escapade is outfitted for offshore, multi-day operations with efficient dive procedures, ample deck space, and gear and fish storage. Anchoring and drift strategies are chosen to match conditions and the group’s goals.
data.itinerary:
We meet at the boat on the evening of the departure date, load the boat, and drive through the night while you sleep.

Dawn and dusk are often the most productive times so we like to get diving early. Once you're ready for a break come back to the boat, warm up with the outdoor hot water shower, and breakfast will be waiting for you. The rest of the day will be exploring new spots at the islands or searching open water for kelp paddies and schools of tuna, depending on what the weather and the fish are doing. This will go until you're too tired to dive or the sun goes down, whichever comes first. Relax on deck, throw a line over the side for some rod&reel action, it's totally up to you. 

Same thing for the next day, the only difference being when you are done diving we will start heading back to San Diego. You sleep, we drive, and when you wake up we'll be back where we started

data.what_is_not_included:
CA fishing license (required)
Pillowcase and blanket/sleeping bag
Alcoholic beverages
Reusable water bottle as well as a thermos for coffee/tea
Spearfishing and diving gear
Towel or changing parka
Sunscreen or other sun protection
Ear drops, vaseline, etc if needed
2 sets of clothes - bring extra layers
1 for daytime that can get wet, dirty, and will keep you dry and warm
1 for night, typically sweats
Tip for captain and deck hand is customary, and much appreciated

While the Escapade is nice and roomy, having 4 sets of dive gear, spear guns, and clothes can take up space quickly. Don't leave any essentials behind, but try to minimize your gear footprint (leave your cooler in your car)

data.booking_notes:
Thanks for booking your 2.5-day overnight spearing or freediving trip with us aboard *Escapade*! We’re pumped to have you join us for this offshore adventure.

Here’s everything you need to know before we head out:

---

**🚤 Trip Overview**  
- **Pickup Location:** Dana Landing, Mission Bay  
- **Parking:** Please park at the **Freedom Boat Club lot**  
   - 📍 [Freedom Boat Club – Mission Bay Location](https://www.google.com/maps/place/Freedom+Boat+Club+San+Diego/@32.761884,-117.239007,17z)  
- We’ll depart in the **evening**, traveling overnight while you sleep.  
- You’ll spend **three nights aboard Escapade**:  
   - Night 1: Traveling out  
   - Night 2: Anchored after the first dive day  
   - Night 3: Traveling back  
- You’ll wake up ready to dive both mornings, and we’ll return early morning on the third day.

---

**🧳 What to Bring**  
- **California fishing license** – required for all spearfishing and fishing  
- **Your own dive gear**  
- A **pillowcase** (we provide the pillows)  
- **Sleeping bag or linens** for your bunk (a sleeping bag usually works best)  
- **Warm layers** – nights on the water can get chilly, and there’s nothing worse than being cold at sea  
- **Fishing rods** (optional, but you're welcome to bring them)  
- **One dive bag + one dry bag** with clothes and personal items is usually perfect  
- Any **specialty snacks or alcoholic beverages** you’d like to bring (we’ll have food and drinks covered)

---

**🎯 Gear Availability**  
We’ll have a selection of **tuna guns with full setups**, as well as **mid-range guns** that are perfect for kelp paddies and island diving—ideal for species like yellowtail, white seabass, and mahi mahi.  
Just let us know in advance what you’ll need so we can make sure we’ve got it onboard and ready to go.

---

If you have any **food allergies or dietary restrictions**, please let us know ahead of time so we can plan accordingly.

The crew will be working hard for you and tips go a long way! Cash, Venmo and Zelle all work great

We’re looking forward to a killer trip filled with good dives, good people, and good times. If you have any questions before we head out, just shoot us a message.

See you soon!

Best,
